items.title: Gantt dependency connectors drawn at the wrong scale (svg height from aspect ratio); no arrowheads
items.instruction: The svg .tessera-gantt-connectors has top:0/bottom:0 but height auto, so as a replaced element it takes its height from the viewBox ratio. Give it an explicit height, `height: calc(var(--tessera-gantt-rows) * var(--tessera-gantt-row))`, setting --tessera-gantt-rows as a style prop in GanttLayout.tsx (css-token convention: define it on the other side of the css/ts pair). Draw the paths in CSS pixels: measure the row height from the first rendered row, as dayWidth already is (decision 90), so coarse 44px rows work. Do not use a scaled viewBox: arrowheads would distort under preserveAspectRatio=none. Add a `<marker>` arrowhead (marker-end) on every path, in currentColor, with the conflict paths in the error colour, and end the path at the bar's inset edge (bars are inset by --spacing-1), not at the day boundary. Apply the same pattern to the modules timeline if it ever draws connectors (decision 108 says none).
items.expected: svg height = rows x row height in every zoom and at 375 touch; endpoint dy against the row centres <= 1px for all edges; each path has an arrowhead pointing at the blocked item's start (decision 92)
items.verify: timeline/conn.mjs, all zooms at 1440 and 375 (results-conn.json ratio 1.0, paths[].dyStart/dyEnd <= 1); timeline/measure.mjs ONLY=gantt-month: gantt.connectorMarkers > 0, both schemes

needs_decision.question: How should 44px touch targets at 375 be applied: one theme-wide rule or per lane?
needs_decision.why: Every auditor found tens of controls under 44 at 375 (the brief rates that high). Only grips, a few tabs and some analytics/settings buttons have a 44px rule. A theme rule fixes the chrome at once but changes Astryx control sizes everywhere at <=480px. Dense in-row chips and table cells need a hit-area expansion, not a visual size change.
options: A: theme-wide coarse/480 rule on Astryx Button, IconButton, Tab, Switch, MenuItem and Segmented (shell lane, S1), plus per-lane hit-area expansion for dense rows (items L7, B11, T2, D3, P12, St3, Pg5, W6)
B: per-lane rules only, as home.css and analytics.css do today (~9 lanes repeat the same media block)
C: record a trade-off: 44 only for primary actions, grips and tabs; dense in-row controls stay 20-28 on phones
needs_decision.recommendation: A. One theme rule, plus hit-area expansion (padding with an equal negative margin) for chips and cells, so the 1440 density and the 375 row look stay as they are. The items are written for A; under B, S1 shrinks to the shell's own screens.
